rationale: The Latin anchors *apparebo* ("I shall appear") and *micare* ("to gleam/shine") in the Psalm context (Ps. 16:15, 51:9) point to a concrete sense of coming into sight or becoming visible — specifically shining white ("super nivem dealbabor," "I shall be whiter than snow"). This is a literal, visual appearing/becoming visible, best captured by appear.v.02 ("come into sight or view") rather than the seeming/impression senses.
